import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

## Objective
- Build a polished 2D fighting game called **BLADE ARENA** in the empty PlayGround repo, fulfilling all requested features and validating it in-browser.

## Requirements
- Two playable fighters; punch, kick, block, special attacks; smooth combat animations.
- Health + energy bars, combo system, character selection, three arenas.
- CPU opponent with fighting AI; best-of-three matches.
- Special-attack visual effects; mobile buttons and keyboard support.
- Real hit detection, damage, blocking, working controls.
- Reference attachment: anime-style fighting game HUD with top health bars, portraits, timer, energy gauges, bottom round pips.

## Decisions
- Vanilla HTML/CSS/ES modules + Canvas renderer, served as static site by runtime.
- Fully procedural vector fighter rigs and arena art; no external image assets.
- Two fighters: **AKIRA / FROSTFANG** (cyan, fast, ice projectile) and **RAZE / CRIMSON RONIN** (red, heavy, fire projectile).
- Three arenas: **NEON DISTRICT**, **FROST SHRINE**, **EMBER FOUNDRY**.
- Best-of-three rounds, 99-second timer, 1000/1080 HP, block chip damage, energy cost 50 for special, punch→kick→special chain cancels.
- Procedural WebAudio SFX/music, no audio assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and all game modules: `js/data.js`, `js/rig.js`, `js/world.js`, `js/game.js`, `js/audio.js`, `js/main.js`.
- Implemented title, character select, arena select, help, pause, gameplay HUD, match-over screens.
- Implemented combat engine with hitboxes/hurtboxes, damage scaling, blocking, combos, projectiles, KO/time-up, round transitions, AI.
- Implemented keyboard + touch controls, responsive layout, HUD, announcer, camera/shake/hitstop/effects.
- Static server running in tmux session `blade` on `http://localhost:3002`.
- Playwright screenshots verified no page errors: `title.png`, `select.png`, `select-raze.png`, `fight-intro.png`, `fight-punch.png`, `fight-kick.png`, `fight-special.png`, `fight-later.png` in `/tmp/opencode/shots`.

### Active
- Visual QA and bug-fixing from screenshots.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Fix Akira idle sword pose: blade currently crosses near face/neck; change idle/walk blade angle to point up-forward (e.g. around `2.2`) or otherwise reposition.
2. Hide demo fighters on character-select screen (currently faint giant silhouettes behind cards); keep demo only on title.
3. Verify punch/kick/special actually connect and animate; inspect `fight-kick.png`, `fight-special.png`, `fight-later.png`.
4. Test blocking, combos, CPU behavior, round/match flow, mobile layout, and touch buttons with Playwright.
5. Polish visual issues found, then rerun desktop + mobile captures and ensure no errors.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: all screens/HUD/touch markup.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: full polished UI/responsive styling.

## Objective
- Build a polished 2D fighting game called **BLADE ARENA** in the empty PlayGround repo, fulfilling all requested features and validating it in-browser.

## Requirements
- Two playable fighters; punch, kick, block, special attacks; smooth combat animations.
- Health + energy bars, combo system, character selection, three arenas.
- CPU opponent with fighting AI; best-of-three matches.
- Special-attack visual effects; mobile buttons and keyboard support.
- Real hit detection, damage, blocking, working controls.
- Reference attachment: anime-style fighting game HUD with top health bars, portraits, timer, energy gauges, bottom round pips.

## Decisions
- Vanilla HTML/CSS/ES modules + Canvas renderer, served as static site.
- Fully procedural vector fighter rigs and arena art; no external image assets.
- Fighters: **AKIRA / FROSTFANG** (cyan, fast, ice projectile) and **RAZE / CRIMSON RONIN** (red, heavy, fire projectile).
- Arenas: **NEON DISTRICT**, **FROST SHRINE**, **EMBER FOUNDRY**.
- Best-of-three rounds, 99-second timer, 1000/1080 HP, block chip damage, energy cost 50 for special, punch→kick→special chain cancels.
- Procedural WebAudio SFX/music, no audio assets.
- Fixed bugs in round/match flow and improved performance by caching static arena art and batching particles.
- Use headless Chromium with default launch flags (`headless: true, args: []`) for QA; the runtime's SwiftShader Vulkan flags reduce rendering to ~2 fps.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and all game modules (`js/data.js`, `js/rig.js`, `js/world.js`, `js/game.js`, `js/audio.js`, `js/main.js`).
- Implemented title, character select, arena select, help, pause, gameplay HUD, match-over screens.
- Implemented combat engine with hitboxes/hurtboxes, damage scaling, blocking, combos, projectiles, KO/time-up, round transitions, AI.
- Implemented keyboard + touch controls, responsive layout, HUD, announcer, camera/shake/hitstop/effects.
- Fixed Akira idle sword angle so it no longer crosses the face/neck.
- Hid demo fighter silhouettes on character-select screen; title still shows them.
- Fixed match-end crash: `updateFighterVisuals` → `updateVisualOnly`.
- Fixed `matchEnd` callback to pass the winner key instead of the fighter object.
- Added static arena background cache (`drawArenaCached`) and batching for rain/snow/embers/dust in `js/world.js`.
- Comprehensive desktop/mobile QA passed: movement, punch (46 dmg), 2-hit combo, block chip (7 HP), special (50 energy, 145 dmg), round 2, match 2–0, pause, AI behavior, touch controls.
- All current screenshots have no page errors (`DESKTOP_ERRORS []`, `MOBILE_ERRORS []`).

### Active
- Final visual polish, especially mobile character-select layout and Ember Foundry arena detail.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Verify mobile character-select changes: cards stacked without footer overlap, arena heading visible, all three arena cards reachable.
2. Improve Ember Foundry visual detail/contrast (currently sparse/dark relative to other arenas).
3. Recapture final desktop and mobile screenshots after fixes; rerun QA to confirm no regressions or page errors.
4. Review all screens one last time for clipping, overlap, and readability.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/world.js`: arena rendering, new arena cache, particles/effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: combat engine, rounds, match-end callback fix.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/rig.js`: fighter rig, poses, sword angles.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: app flow, menus, input, HUD, previews; exposes `window.__blade` for QA.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: responsive layout; mobile select fixes at `@media (max-width: 480px)`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: all screen/HUD/touch markup.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: fighters, attacks, arenas, key map.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: WebAudio SFX/music.
- `/tmp/opencode/qa2.mjs`: comprehensive desktop/mobile QA script.
- `/tmp/opencode/shots/`: QA screenshots.
- `/tmp/opencode/shot.mjs`: simpler Playwright screenshot script.

## Important Context
- Static server runs in tmux session `blade` at `http://localhost:3002`; logs at `/tmp/opencode/blade-server.log`.
- QA uses headless Chromium with `headless: true, args: []`; software Vulkan config yields ~2 fps.
- Runtime config is `~/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json`; its launch args include SwiftShader Vulkan.
- `window.__blade` exposes `{ app, controls, renderer, get game() }` for testing.
- All changes are uncommitted in the working tree.
- `qa2.mjs` currently leaves the mobile select layout untested after the latest CSS edit.
